title: Wednesday assorted links
contentHtml:
1. The cheese collateral in Italian banks is melting.

2. Denmark fact of the day: “…half of Denmark’s growth has been due to essentially one company”

3. “Foreign travel now makes up 1.4% of the US consumer spending budget. By contrast, imported Chinese goods make up about 3% of US domestic expenditures.”

4. Noah is right.

5. “For decades, men have been increasing their share of housework and child care. But the number of babies just keeps falling.”

6. Christopher Phelan confirmed as new CEA chair.
